visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female presenter with long dark hair, wearing a white ribbed V-neck sweater, stands before a dark blue wall with gold geometric lines. She holds a large beige bag patterned with cartoon dogs and smiles at the camera. (2) Cut to a baby in a yellow lion-themed onesie sleeping on patterned bedding in a wooden crib. The camera pans across the infant's restful posture. (3) Return to the presenter in the studio, using hand gestures to emphasize her points. (4) A smartphone screen recording shows a baby monitor view at night, depicting the child sleeping under a white blanket. (5) The presenter holds up the 'aribebe' bag, demonstrating its size and handles. (6) A sequence follows where hands lay out the integrated bedding—pillow, mat, and blanket—into the crib. (7) Close-ups of the fabric patterns featuring foxes and trees are shown. (8) A travel clip shows the presenter in a white dress, outdoors in Mexico, holding the rolled-up bedding while carrying the baby. (9) Back in the studio, she displays a 'cooling' version of the mat, which has a white, quilted, honeycomb texture. (10) A cartoon owl character overlays the screen during certain humorous segments. (11) Final shot shows the presenter smiling and waving while holding the product.
